Name: Ancient Seeds - Four Seasons Crafting
Author: wei2fun
Description:
**Description**
Craft **Ancient Seeds** by combining the four seasonal wild seed types (Spring/Summer/Fall/Winter Seeds).

**Installation instructions**
1. Install SMAPI and Content Patcher.
2. Unzip and put the `AncientSeedCrafting` folder into your `Mods` folder.
3. Launch the game with SMAPI.

**Main features**
- Combine Spring + Summer + Fall + Winter Seeds into **Ancient Seeds** (grows Ancient Fruit).
- Default recipe: 10 of each seasonal seed → 1 Ancient Seed.
- Ingredient amount configurable (1–99) via Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM).
- Recipe auto-learned at **Foraging level 9**, shown as a new crafting recipe in the level-up popup.
- Config labels localized in all 12 official Stardew Valley languages.

**Requirements**
- SMAPI 4.x
- Content Patcher 2.0+
- (Optional, recommended) Generic Mod Config Menu — to change the ingredient amount in-game

**Shout outs**
- Thanks to [Pathoschild](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/2389811) for SMAPI and Content Patcher.
- Thanks to [spacechase0](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/2966270) for Generic Mod Config Menu.
- Thanks to the Stardew Valley modding community for their support.
